chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb and Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl, from his father, from ʿAlī ibn ʿUqbah and Dhubyān ibn Ḥakīm, from Mūsā ibn Ukayl al-Numayrī, from al-ʿAlāʾ ibn Sayyābah, who said:

Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام was asked, while I was present, about a man who was killed and his head was cut off in disobedience to Allah: should he be given ghusl, or should what is done with a martyr be done with him?

He said: “If he was killed in disobedience to Allah, the blood is first washed from him, then water is poured over him thoroughly, and his body is not rubbed. One begins with the hands and the anus, and his wounds are tied with cotton and threads. When the cotton is placed upon him, it is bound, and likewise the place of the head, meaning the neck. A large amount of cotton should be placed for him, and the ḥanūṭ is sprinkled upon it. Then the cotton is placed over the neck, and if you are able to bind it, then do so.”
I said: If the head has become separated from the body, while it is with him, how should he be washed?

He said: “He should wash the head when he washes the hands and the lower part; one begins with the head, then with the body. Then cotton is placed over the neck, and the head is joined to it and placed in the shroud. Likewise, when you come to the grave, you take it along with the body, place him into the laḥd, and turn him toward the qiblah.”

key_terms.الشَّهِيدِ: the martyr; mentioned here for comparison of funeral treatment
key_terms.اللَّحْدَ: the burial niche in the grave
key_terms.الْحَنُوطُ: camphor-based funerary perfume applied to the deceased
key_terms.الْقُطْنِ: cotton; used to cover and bind wounds and the neck area
key_terms.الْقِبْلَةِ: the direction of prayer toward which the deceased is turned in burial
key_terms.الْكَفَنِ: the shroud in which the deceased is wrapped
key_terms.مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ: disobedience to Allah; the circumstance affecting the burial ruling
key_terms.يُغْسَلُ: he is washed; the deceased is to be given ritual washing

ai.seo_question: How should a decapitated body be given ghusl and burial according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the rulings for washing and preparing the body of a person killed in disobedience to Allah when the body has severe wounds or the head has been severed. It details how blood is removed, how cotton and binding are used for the wounds and neck, and how the head is washed, shrouded, and buried together with the body facing the qiblah.
